h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Udaipur

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Udaipur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Udaipur

c: Udaipur's lakes and palaces bring visitors all year, and the city has more hotels and resorts than most towns its size. Many of them now offer guests a place to exercise in the open air. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Udaipur for hotels, resorts, schools, colleges, residential colonies and parks. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 590 km away, and we bring the machines to Rajasthan by road.

For a hotel, the gym has to look neat in a garden and suit guests of all fitness levels. For a colony park or college, it has to take daily use from many people. We plan each differently, send a layout drawing and install with our own team or a dealer in north India once you approve. Resorts on the city outskirts often have more lawn space and can take a larger set.

richText.heading: An outdoor gym corner for a hotel or resort

items.q: Can outdoor gym colours be matched to a hotel's design?
items.a: Yes. Seats and handles are roto-moulded in 15+ colour shades, so you can choose colours that suit your property. Ask our sales team about options.

items.q: Which outdoor gym machines suit hotel guests?
items.a: Simple, low-impact machines such as walkers, cycles and tai chi wheels. Guests can use them without instruction, and they suit a wide spread of ages.

items.q: How far is Udaipur from your factory?
items.a: About 590 km. We make the equipment in Vasai, near Mumbai, send it by road and install it through our team or a dealer in north India.
